changelog:
v4.2.6 — Series playback fix for Fire TV Stick Lite / older sticks

• Fixes series episodes and movies freezing on the first frame (audio plays, picture stuck, then "video format not supported") on Fire TV Stick Lite and similar older devices. Dolby audio tracks now decode with the app's built-in decoder on these devices at every channel count — the hardware Dolby decoder on this chip silently stalls and was freezing the whole player.
• Includes all v4.2.4/v4.2.5 fixes: 4K hardware playback, Dolby Vision support, crash fixes, Continue Watching repair.

Non-Dolby and newer devices are unchanged.
